summary: Standards (mutation probe of the new owner; checker.md 1.3.1 L2.input-fragment/-normalise/-env: data is compared strictly except the volatile paths): nothing proves that a real difference in `data` between the document form and the argv form fails. I removed "/data" from the compared pointers in differences() (crates/atip-check/src/checks/l2/input.rs:107) and ran atip_checkl2input (32 passed) and seeded_violations (31 passed): the mutant SURVIVES (a second reviewer run found the same). No fake-tool knob makes the two forms differ in data alone: dataStamp makes it volatile (kept out on purpose), inputRequiresArgv differs in ok and exit. So the ruling 3/4 code (varying_paths, masking) is proven only for the paths it leaves out, never for the paths it keeps. Fix: a knob that changes one non-volatile data member in the document form and an input-fragment/data-differs case in support/l2.rs that fails L2.input-fragment alone; the same for -normalise. Until then atip.checkl2input.09 is not signed by me.
